# Composed ignore rules; see the foundation plan for source hashes.

# Profile: rust-build
# Empathy Rust build overlay; select the Cargo workspace/project root explicitly.
# Anchoring keeps unrelated nested target/ source directories visible.
/target/

# Repository-owned local additions.
# Empathy-owned integration rules; see docs/foundation/gitignore/MIGRATION-03.md.
# Generated quality reports; retain the existing curated evidence exceptions.
/.reports/*
!/.reports/README.md
!/.reports/egolint/
/.reports/egolint/*
!/.reports/egolint/architecture/
!/.reports/egolint/architecture/README.md
!/.reports/egolint/architecture/lint-architecture.svg
!/.reports/megalinter/
/.reports/megalinter/*
!/.reports/megalinter/remediation.md

# Repository intelligence and the selected root Mindgarden/Obsidian vault.
/docs/generated/
/.garden.local/
/.garden/.index/
/.obsidian/plugins/
/.obsidian/workspace*.json

# Root Python tooling: observed Ruff cache and the configured pytest project.
/.ruff_cache/
/.pytest_cache/

# Imported Cargo projects without their own ignore file; root Rust uses the overlay.
/beacon/target/
/.staging/devenvironment/realm/target/

# Executable language fixtures, scoped to their owning projects.
/egolint/tests/fixtures/raku/**/.precomp/
/egolint/tests/fixtures/dart-analyzer/.dart_tool/
/egolint/tests/fixtures/dart-analyzer/.packages
/.staging/.github/skills/winmd-api-search/scripts/cache-generator/bin/
/.staging/.github/skills/winmd-api-search/scripts/cache-generator/obj/

# Private key material mounted by the imported Apache development configuration.
# Public certificates and keys used as reviewed fixtures elsewhere remain visible.
/.staging/devenvironment/containers/services/apache/certs/**/*.key

# Private Terraform state, plans, and auto-loaded variables at the actual IaC fixtures.
# Other private material belongs in .secrets/; reviewed *.tfvars elsewhere stay visible.
/egolint/tests/fixtures/kics/terraform/.terraform/
/egolint/tests/fixtures/kics/terraform/terraform.tfstate
/egolint/tests/fixtures/kics/terraform/terraform.tfstate.*
/egolint/tests/fixtures/kics/terraform/.terraform.tfstate.lock.info
/egolint/tests/fixtures/kics/terraform/terraform.tfvars
/egolint/tests/fixtures/kics/terraform/terraform.tfvars.json
/egolint/tests/fixtures/kics/terraform/*.auto.tfvars
/egolint/tests/fixtures/kics/terraform/*.auto.tfvars.json
/egolint/tests/fixtures/kics/terraform/*.tfplan
/egolint/tests/fixtures/tflint/.terraform/
/egolint/tests/fixtures/tflint/terraform.tfstate
/egolint/tests/fixtures/tflint/terraform.tfstate.*
/egolint/tests/fixtures/tflint/.terraform.tfstate.lock.info
/egolint/tests/fixtures/tflint/terraform.tfvars
/egolint/tests/fixtures/tflint/terraform.tfvars.json
/egolint/tests/fixtures/tflint/*.auto.tfvars
/egolint/tests/fixtures/tflint/*.auto.tfvars.json
/egolint/tests/fixtures/tflint/*.tfplan
/egolint/tests/fixtures/negative/terraform-fmt/.terraform/
/egolint/tests/fixtures/negative/terraform-fmt/terraform.tfstate
/egolint/tests/fixtures/negative/terraform-fmt/terraform.tfstate.*
/egolint/tests/fixtures/negative/terraform-fmt/.terraform.tfstate.lock.info
/egolint/tests/fixtures/negative/terraform-fmt/terraform.tfvars
/egolint/tests/fixtures/negative/terraform-fmt/terraform.tfvars.json
/egolint/tests/fixtures/negative/terraform-fmt/*.auto.tfvars
/egolint/tests/fixtures/negative/terraform-fmt/*.auto.tfvars.json
/egolint/tests/fixtures/negative/terraform-fmt/*.tfplan

# Universal baseline (last in every declared scope).
# Empathy universal ignore baseline; see docs/foundation/gitignore/README.md.
# Registered for composition plans; active-root adoption is a separate step.

# Operating-system metadata.
.DS_Store
.AppleDouble
.LSOverride
._*
Thumbs.db
Desktop.ini
$RECYCLE.BIN/

# Editor-local state; shared .idea/ and .vscode/ configuration stays visible.
*~
*.swp
*.swo
**/.idea/workspace.xml
**/.idea/usage.statistics.xml
**/.idea/shelf/

# Local environments. Template suffixes are deliberate, not prefix matches.
.env
.env.*
!.env.example
!.env.sample
!.env.template
!.env.*.example
!.env.*.sample
!.env.*.template

# Reserved private local namespace; public keys and fixtures stay visible.
.secrets/

# Unambiguous local caches, environments, and installed dependencies.
.cache/
.tmp/
.venv/
__pycache__/
node_modules/

# Language/build outputs, logs, reports, and credential extensions need
# profile or repository ownership. Do not add universal bin/, build/, dist/,
# out/, target/, vendor/, *.log, *.key, or whole-editor-directory rules.
# Lockfiles, reviewed artifacts, and shared configuration remain trackable.
# A blanket .gitkeep negation cannot reopen an ignored parent directory.
